title: Harvard CS 121: Introduction to Theoretical Computer Science (Fall 2020) – Madhu Sudan
description: ## Madhu Sudan: Harvard CS 121, Fall 2020: Introduction to Theoretical Computer Science. ### **Teaching team: Harvard CS 121: Introduction to Theoretical Computer Science (Fall 2020):**. We’re very excited to have an amazing cohort of TFs and Patel Fellows associated with the course! 1. Attendance in **lecture**is strongly recommended but not required. Students unable to attend lecture are expected to watch the videos within 24 hours of posting, and follow up on this in sections and office hours. 3. **Office hours** are available for students to engage further in the material and to get help on material. Course announcements will be made on Piazza, which students are expected to check. * Course discussion and some announcements will be on Piazza. Homework 0 (tex, pdf), which is due on the first day of class (but not part of your problem set grade) is intended to help you diagnose your mathematical background; we’ll grade it and talk with you about it if appropriate.
